subject: general
question: According to Global Multidimensional Poverty Index 2022, what was the population of the poor in India in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**228.9 million**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to the Global Multidimensional Poverty Index 2022, the population of the poor in India in 2020 was **228.9 million**.
 
• The Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) is published by the **United Nations Development Programme (UNDP)** and the **Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHI)**.
 
• The MPI considers multiple deprivations across health, education, and living standards, offering a comprehensive measure of poverty.
 
• India has shown significant progress in reducing multidimensional poverty over the years, but challenges remain in addressing inequalities.
 
• The report highlights the need for targeted policies to address the various dimensions of poverty and improve overall well-being.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI)**:

 
 
• Introduced in 2010, it measures poverty beyond income-based metrics, considering factors like health, education, and living standards.
 
• Each dimension is equally weighted and includes indicators such as nutrition, child mortality, years of schooling, and access to sanitation.
 
 
 
• **Global Trends**:
 
 
• The MPI report provides insights into global poverty trends, highlighting regions and countries that have made significant progress or face major challenges.
 
• Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia are regions with the highest levels of multidimensional poverty.
 
 
 
• **Policy Implications**:
 
 
• Data from the MPI report are used by policymakers to design and implement effective poverty alleviation programs.
 
• Policies focusing on health, education, and basic living conditions are crucial for addressing multidimensional poverty.
 
 
 
• **Poverty Reduction Strategies**:
 
 
• Strategies like social safety nets, education reforms, and healthcare accessibility are essential in reducing poverty.
 
• Community-driven development and inclusive economic growth also play significant roles in poverty reduction.
